lines.zh: 我一步一步走过来，地都在响。
lines.en: I walk on and the ground answers every step.
This body of mine is three blocks wide.
My shoulder brushes the treetops.

lines.zh: 我踩过木栅栏，栅栏就没了。
lines.en: I walk over a fence and it is gone.
The treetops only reach my chest.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，可速度不慢。
lines.en: My stride drags, but it is not slow.

lines.zh: 每走一步，土就从树冠掉。
lines.en: Every step shakes dirt from the treetops.
I smash a door and keep walking.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过去，不留退路。
lines.en: I advance step by step, leaving no retreat.

lines.zh: 我低下头，躲过一根横梁。
lines.en: I duck under a beam.
I stand and my breathing is heavy.
The crystals on my body are glowing.
I press my fingers into the cliff.

lines.zh: 周围没有东西能挡住我。
lines.en: There is nothing here that can stop me.
I turn my upper body slowly.

lines.zh: 有一只鸟落在我肩上，飞走了。
lines.en: A bird landed on my shoulder and left.
I raise a hand and clouds pass between my fingers.
The ground around my feet has split.

lines.zh: 我在听，很远的声音都听得见。
lines.en: I listen. I hear a long way off.

lines.zh: 我低头看着自己踩出的坑。
lines.en: I look down at the hollow my foot left.

lines.zh: 我站直，头顶的云被顶开。
lines.en: I straighten and the cloud above parts.

lines.zh: 我的胸口有一块暗色的石。
lines.en: There is a dark stone set in my chest.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把一只脚抬起来。
lines.en: Slowly I lift one foot.

lines.zh: 我听见风从晶体缝里过。
lines.en: I hear wind pass through the crystal seams.
I watch the distance a while.

lines.zh: 我低下头，活动了一下脖子。
lines.en: I lower my head and roll my neck.

lines.zh: 你的武器在我眼里太短。
lines.en: Your weapon looks too short to me.
You stand only as high as my knee.
You are shorter than my finger.
I do not know you, and do not need to.
Do you think you can run?
This place is mine.

lines.zh: 我的手臂比你整个人长。
lines.en: My arm is longer than you are tall.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，看起来很小。
lines.en: Standing there, you look very small.

lines.zh: 我身上这些石头，比铁硬。
lines.en: The stone on me is harder than iron.
I have raised both hands.

lines.zh: 我不用弯腰就能看清你。
lines.en: I can see you clearly without stooping.
You should not stand by that wall.
That struck the stone of me.
I take a step back and the ground splits.
Such a wound does not concern me.
I brush the chips away.
One crystal has cracked.
I press the wound and look at it.

lines.zh: 我用手背擦掉肩上的裂片。
lines.en: I wipe the split shards off my shoulder.
My blood runs slowly.

lines.zh: 晶体碎屑从我肩上落下。
lines.en: Crystal grit falls off my shoulder.
The dark stone at my core still beats.

lines.zh: 那点东西，连我一口都不够。
lines.en: That is not a mouthful for me.

lines.zh: 我站住了，看着那个方向。
lines.en: I stop and look that way.
What you hold up is too small.

lines.zh: 四格七的个头，低头闻你。
lines.en: Four blocks tall, I lower my head to sniff.
I pinch it and it crumbles.
That does not smell meant for me.

lines.zh: 我不管你是不是想让开。
lines.en: I do not care whether it is offered.
I swallow it and taste nothing.

lines.zh: 你把那点东西举得再高些。
lines.en: Hold that little thing higher still.
Now that it is done, I am still here.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞在崖壁上。
lines.en: You hit me like a cliff face.
I did not move at all.
You backed off. Better.
Not enough to make me look down.
I am taking a step. Get clear.
My leg is thicker than you are.
The floor rang under you.

lines.zh: 你撞得自己退了好几步。
lines.en: That knocked you back several paces.
You slide off past my toe.

lines.zh: 再撞我一次，我就当你是敌人。
lines.en: Once more and I count you an enemy.
I was made, not born.
There is no other of my kind, and I never thought of it.

lines.zh: 我的身体是石头和别的东西拼的。
lines.en: This body is stone and other things joined.

lines.zh: 这种身体，不会有什么后代。
lines.en: Such a body brings no offspring.

lines.zh: 我在这里站了很久，也就够了。
lines.en: I have stood here long. That is enough.

lines.zh: 有时我想，谁把我做成这样。
lines.en: Sometimes I wonder who shaped me this way.

lines.zh: 那个人大概已经不在了。
lines.en: That one is probably long gone.
I neither hate nor thank him.
I only need to keep walking.
Standing still is the quietest.
I pick up a length of trunk.
Too light. It snaps in my grip.
I push stones out of the way.

lines.zh: 这枚东西在我手里像沙。
lines.en: It feels like sand in my hand.
I toss it aside.
Nothing on the ground is of use to me.
I lift a whole slab of stone.
I crush it.
I do not even have to bend.
I drag it a way.

lines.zh: 三格宽的我，木门也挡不住。
lines.en: Three blocks wide. A wooden door will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我转过身，地面被压出印。
lines.en: I turn and the ground takes the print.
I step over the low wall, bricks still falling.
It is smaller than a stone.
I raise a hand to block its path.
It stops and looks up.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，把木门整块拆下。
lines.en: I bend down and pull the wooden door off whole.
It has backed to the wall.
There is no other way out.

lines.zh: 我的脚踏上石桥，桥就弯。
lines.en: I set foot on the stone bridge and it sags.
My shadow falls over it.
It has started shouting.
It climbed a low wall.
I step over it and the wall collapses.
It is running for the village.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可它跑不远。
lines.en: I am not fast, but it will not get far.
There is open ground ahead.
I will wait for it there.
I watch it climb.
It got halfway and slid down.
I walk over and it runs again.
It cannot circle past me.
My step cracks the ground.
It stops at the edge of the crack.
Slowly I close my fist.
It looks up, then down.
I lift my foot.
It rolls aside.
Half a step more.
I plant myself between it and the door.
It is hiding in one of the houses.
I push with one hand and the roof falls in.
It crawls out of the rubble.
I stand and let it find its feet.
It looks at me a while and does not move.

lines.zh: 我这副躯壳有四米多高。
lines.en: This body of mine stands over four meters.
It shifts half a step left.
And I turn half a body left.

lines.zh: 我双手合起来，砸向地面。
lines.en: I bring both hands down together on the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下把地面砸出一个坑。
lines.en: That leaves a crater in the ground.
I leap and come down on it.
My weight pins it.
I take hold and lift it.
I throw it several yards.
I go through the wall behind it.
I raise my hand and strike again.
It rolls clear.
I turn and close in.
My knee drives into its chest.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的手臂，抓不住。
lines.en: It grips my arm and cannot hold.
I drive my knee through its armor.
The whole floor gives way.
I rise out of the light.
My head is level with the canopy.
I land and dust fans out.

lines.zh: 身上的晶体一片片亮起来。
lines.en: The crystals on me light one by one.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼睛，看着这片地。
lines.en: I open my eyes and look at this land.
I stand first, then look around.
My shadow lies strangely long.
The grass under me is flattened.
Nothing else dares move.
I take the first step and the ground sinks.
I crush the first stone step underfoot.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看了看这只手。
lines.en: I raise a hand and study it.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次站在这里。
lines.en: This is my first time standing here.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，看清了方向。
lines.en: I turn and find my direction.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲上落了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of dust settles on my shoulder.
The light behind me has not faded.
I set my feet apart.
This clearing barely holds me.
I raise a hand against the smoke.

lines.zh: 我听见有东西在远处跑。
lines.en: I hear something running far off.
Fire caught a crystal and I swatted it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸出大坑。
lines.en: I fall from height and leave a wide crater.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的头，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water closed over my head and I sank.

lines.zh: 爆响把我推得倒退两步。
lines.en: The blast shoved me two steps back.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的手臂。
lines.en: Something is lodged in my arm.
Strange light burns on my body.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，可这身体在衰。
lines.en: I need no food, yet this body fails.

lines.zh: 雷打在我肩上，晶体亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my shoulder and the crystals lit.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，有四格多高。
lines.en: This body of mine is over four blocks tall.
